(2) The declared HS 420231 (leather articles / handbags) is inconsistent with the claimed industry 'Food & FMCG'; per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual product line once the entity is identified. Role left as 'unknown' because no evidence of manufacturing vs trading was obtainable. NOT rejected: absence of public data is not proof of non-existence, and no evidence of strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy was found. Recommended next step: re-run verification when search access is restored, or obtain the GSTIN/PAN directly from the supplier and check it on the GST portal and MCA master data.
